about: Large documents in the web platform export (Helix_Large_knowledge_base.zip, built by make_large_kb.py + make_web_bundle.py): an ~80-page service manual with facts deep inside and one ~30,000-character section, a complete 500-row parts table, a partly exported 2,000-row log, and the six Helix documents as distractors. Plus the follow-up case from the final test.
